notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Big shout out to our Bug Hunters who help us ensure that this game is relatively bug free! We've got a big fix and a small update ahead for you. 

[h2]New Updates: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Added relic prizes to Dr. Corvid's Lab. - When you win a challenge, you'll receive relics you can use to purchase new skins.
[*] Added new skins - Make sure to tell Eric how pretty they are if you see him on Discord. He's a skin making machine!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/cc1cdee198c3db2a0688f61458d649ad5715fee4.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a soft lock on Bogarta that was halting player progress. (Thank you Smiles for this find!) 
[*] Changed some of the text on Virball Cores and Boss Names. - The last thing you want to do is let Virballs run havoc in your config files. You never know what they're going to spell out. 
[/list]

notes.title: HotFix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
We're pushing a quick Hotfix! Thanks to Sosich for catching the Relic bug! 

[b]Fixes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Improved achievement tracking to minimize bugs/errors. (If you've earned achievements and haven't gotten them to pop, this update should fix that for you.)
[*] Added a missing relic to Everfin levels. (It was previously supposed to be in Level 4, but our Objective Tiles were punting it out of existence. We stuck it in Level 5 instead.)
[*] Fixed sound issues with Atom Boots, Wind, and Metal Virballs. (You shouldn't get your ears blasted off anymore by the surprising sounds.)
[*] Added a shiny new skin for people who help us find bugs!
[/list]

If you find a bug in the game, please let Nicole know either through Discord or the steam discussion threads. We've got a sweet skin to gift you for your help!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/3b74f427568d0b5bb6cc10fc0cff1ff8d371a52b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/ee821f9e5144fdfafb119fefdd653c68c9852852.png[/img]

If you've helped us hunt down a bug and Nicole hasn't contacted you with a code for this skin yet, please DM her.

notes.title: Hotfix!
notes.notes:
Despite hours of testing, you all found a show stopper on the first day! Some players were encountering a bug where you weren't able to get past the wall separating the boss. 

 Good news! We fixed it =) 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Implemented a fix to prevent the boss wall from causing a soft lock in Scortopia level 1
[/list]

notes.title: Virballs Holiday Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/5156f901f489e90cef7ece10b8b040849423e5f4.png[/img]

We have a big update for you this week, so get comfy and see what's incoming!

[h2]New Additions:[/h2]

First, happy holidays! We're so happy to have you as part of our community. All of the good Orbs get a new [b]Christmas Candy Skin![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/67b498235436be6b4c74ac25f05f8a3247fdb33b.png[/img]

You can find this in your skins menu on the pause menu. 

[h3]Next up is Dr. Corvid's Lab! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/84d9f27844ada5d86178c5d59f07ac4b5d9f526c.png[/img]

We've been teasing our challenge sandbox mode for a while now, and it's finally here!

Players can unlock this new mode through the world menu either with your mouse or gamepad. 

Players will start with 6 challenges to beat. They range in intensity and difficulty from ludicrous to plaid. Good luck, and beware, the bees! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/a58edcf831985a6bd1209bc5a7c958840bf3f58f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Enter The Inferno! (Wave Survival Challenge, 3 Waves)
Fight fire with fire! Face off against various flame-based Virball combinations with only the Fire Virball Core at your disposal.
[*] Survival of the Squishiest (Wave Survival Challenge, 3 Waves)
 Prove that you are worthy of the Water Core by facing off against each Virball combination that has Water as a secondary element.
[*] Quarantine (Exterminate Challenge, Clear 100 in 100 seconds)
 You have 100 seconds to kill 100 Virballs, which will spawn continuously from all sides. Did your time at Janitor school prepare you for this?
[*] Plumbing Duty (Wave Survival Challenge, 4 Waves)
 Some of the pipes in the Lab are seriously blocked up with excess Virium. Each pipe will start out as a trickle, but watch out! The source of each clog is a massive Virball!
[*] Cage Match (Exterminate Challenge, Clear 20 in 60 seconds)
 Stuck in close quarters and with only a drip feed of ammo, you only have one minute left on the clock to defeat your enormous opponent.
[*] Gas Leak (Exterminate Challenge, Clear 50 in 60 seconds)
Be quick about tracking down these tricky stray Air Virballs, or you won't meet your quota!
[/list]
Have fun beating those challenges!

You'll also be able to play in the Sandbox where all cores and virballs are unlocked until full release. 

[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed defect of Collection Badge Obtained - should be more accurate
[*] The Map View now shows the total amount of atoms you’re able to collect and the current amount you are at
[/list]

That's all for now. We'll see you next year, with some exciting new updates and the full release!

notes.title: The Everfin Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Everfin [/h1]

Welcome to Everfin, a planet with beautiful oceans, tropical fauna, and ...an unfortunate infestation of Virballs. They’ve created a cacophony of chaos in a once beautiful world. The server droids have run amok, and the pools are filled with unmentionable creatures. Only Orb can save this planet now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/af7b331a29fdb79d1e07f5bec70a10b70a55442c.jpg[/img]


Beating Jambito means that you’ve unlocked the Water Core which means: New water Virballs combinations. Each of these new Virballs has a different attack. You might just find a new favorite ammo! 

•	Deep
•	Coral
•	Tiki
•	Ice
•	Snow
•	Mine
•	Eel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/8362a93d7a45d19bff5307740ecc61b528f00409.jpg[/img]

Five new levels are ready for you to play! This means that you have all new challenges waiting to be conquered. Here’s what you can expect: 

•	To help you out, we’ve added an additional dash powerup. Jump farther than you’ve ever jumped before!
•	New rescue missions
•	New hunt/exterminate missions
•	New enemies:
•	Clams
•	Nibblefish
•	Server Droids
•	New flying capsule boss

A New Final Boss Awaits: Octoclaw. We’ve upped the stakes with this new boss, and we’ve added some new cinematics to flavor the fun. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/55447a587030b12567b4d114979c8ddc9f4dc711.jpg[/img]


[h2]Other Enhancements[/h2]

Jambito:
•	Added a new intro cinematic to hunt enemies (in level 4)
Other:
•	Updated the status effect for damage types
•	Updates to the world map menu: added atoms icon next to percentages

notes.title: Update 0.1.1-EA
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 0.1.1-EA[/h1]
Hi everyone! First of all, thanks for playing Virballs! We've taken note of the feedback we've received and we have our first patch of Early Access. The details are below. 

[h2]What's New - [/h2]

[list]
[*]Halloween skin is now added
[/list]

You can find your skins here - 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791744/b178c124c07c2f1e059b6999b3b69284e9d9af78.jpg[/img]

[h2]What we fixed -[/h2] 
[list]
[*] World Map will now highlight Jambito by default
[*] Auto aim fix: projectiles don’t inherit velocity, which will help projectiles connect more often (aka, we took your feedback about combat not feeling good and fixed it so that you're more likely to hit your target)
[*] Lightweight save handling update
[/list]
